title: What I Think, And So
label: ch:ar-what-i-think-and-so
canDo: I can ask a question, give my opinion, and say what followed from a reason.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-R285-opinion-and-so: an opinion with fī raʾyī or aʿtaqidu anna, its reason with li-anna, and its result with li-dhālika or fa-.
